mapper.select: select gfpd.*, con.Con_Name as gfpdContractName ,con.Con_Money_Total as gfpdContractAmount ,con.Con_Party_B_Id as gfpdContractCompanyId ,sc1.C_Name as gfpdContractCompanyName, sc2.C_Name as payCompanyName, con.Con_Type as conType, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal from Group_Fund_Plan_Detail gfpd left join Group_Fund_Plan gfp on gfpd.Gfp_Id = gfp.id left join Con_Contract con on gfpd.Gfpd_Contract_Id = con.Con_Id left join SYS_Company sc1 on con.Con_Party_B_Id = sc1.C_ID left join SYS_Company sc2 on gfpd.pay_Company = sc2.C_ID where gfpd.Gfp_Id = #{id} and gfp.del_flag = 0

select gfp.*, pp.P_Name as projectName,pp.P_Competent_Department as projectCompetentDepartmentId,sd.D_Name as projectCompetentDepartmentName, pp.P_Inv_Total as projectInvTotal,pp.P_Approve_Budget_Code as projectApproveBudgetCode, ibd.bd_approval_num as bdApprovalNum,sc.C_Name as gfpApplicationCidName from Group_Fund_Plan gfp left join Pre_Project pp on gfp.Project_ID = pp.P_ID left join SYS_Department sd on pp.P_Competent_Department = sd.D_ID left join Inv_Budget_Declare ibd on pp.P_ID = ibd.P_ID left join SYS_Company sc on gfp.gfp_Application_Cid = sc.C_ID where gfp.id = #{id} and gfp.del_flag = 0
select * from Engineering_Fund_Application efa where efa.P_Id = #{projectId} and efa.State = 7 and efa.Efa_Pay_State = 1
select * from Group_Fund_Plan gfp where gfp.Project_ID = #{projectId} and gfp.State = 7 and gfp.del_flag = 0

select case when mn.P_Project_Form_Type = '01' then mn.P_Approve_Budget when mn.P_Project_Form_Type = '02' then mn.P_Record_Amount when mn.P_Project_Form_Type = '03' then mn.P_Approval_Amount end as projectInvTotal, ibb.Project_Budget_Investment_Amount as projectApproveBudget, icm.Icm_Image_Progress as gfpProjectProgress from Pre_Project mn left join ( select ibb.project_id, ibb.Project_Budget_Investment_Amount from Investment_Budget_Breakdown ibb where ibb.State = 7 and ibb.Project_ID = #{pId} order by Create_Time desc limit 1 ) ibb on mn.P_ID = ibb.Project_ID left join ( select mn.p_id, mn.Icm_Image_Progress from Inv_Complete_Month mn inner join (select p_id, MAX(CONCAT(Icm_Reporting_Year, LPAD(Icm_Reporting_Month, 2, '0'))) as maxYm from Inv_Complete_Month where Icm_Image_Progress is not null and Icm_Image_Progress != '' group by p_id) t on t.p_id = mn.p_id and t.maxYm = CONCAT(mn.Icm_Reporting_Year, LPAD(mn.Icm_Reporting_Month, 2, '0')) order by mn.Icm_Reporting_Year + 0 desc, mn.Icm_Reporting_Month + 0 desc ) icm on mn.P_ID = icm.P_ID where mn.P_ID = #{pId}

select count(1) from (select 1 from Con_Pay cp where cp.cmp_Id = #{cmpId} and cp.Pay_State != 3 union all select 1 from Group_Fund_Plan_Detail gfpd left join Group_Fund_Plan gfp on gfpd.gfp_id = gfp.id where gfp.State != 3 and gfp.del_flag = 0 and gfpd.cmp_Id = #{cmpId}
and gfp.id != #{gfpId} ) temp
